items.label: 3GRATER ATTACHMENTS
items.value: This bowl set comes with 3 different grater attachments (slicing/grating/shredding) just shred or slice right into the bowl! without making a mess and eliminating the need for a cutting board to clean. 4qt had a removable lid inside the main lid, for adding contents or pairing it with your blender without removing the entire lid to prevent splash. For each cook enthusiast, this is a must in a kitchen! All necessary tools for cutting are very handy, easy to keep things clean around you

items.label: NON SLIP SILICONE BOTTOMS
items.value: Most metal mixing bowls is that they will slide on the counter the more vigorously you store items in them. These bowls have a rubber bottom which makes them stick to the counter better making it easier to mix stuff in it. It won't scratch or mark your marble countertops. There is no doubt that the silicone base is more wear-resistant, and you do not need to worry about wear on the bottom of the bowl, or making your marble countertop scratching or leaving marks

items.label: AIRTIGHT BPA FREE LIDS & 5 SIZES BOWLS
items.value: The range of sizes from 5QT down to 1.5QT, makes this set incredibly versatile and suitable for a wide range of tasks. Each bowl comes with a QT label to make it easier to choose the right size. The airtight lids that come with this mixing bowl set make it easy to store ingredients and leftovers to Keep your food fresh for longer without worrying about spills or leaks. Bowl sizes fit on standard-size refrigerator shelves and cabinets.

items.label: NESTING BOWLS & DISHWASHER SAFE
items.value: These kitchen serving bowls can be nested together and offer space-efficient storage in neat kitchen cupboards. The mirrored interior makes cleaning a breeze, This mixing bowl set also is dishwasher-safe, just put it in the dishwasher after use, and you will get a new bowl set. But pay attention that it's best to hand wash the lids, as the heat of the dishwasher can warp them

items: PREMIUM STAINLESS STEEL AND PRESENTS IDEAL This bowl set has a mirrored interior surface and brushed finish exterior for an elegant look. Matte-finish exterior ensuring dent resistance and rustproof. Food-grade stainless steel will not corrode or produce spots after a long time of use, please attention to drying the inside with a cloth to prevent the corrosion of the remaining water after each cleaning. The elegant look and practical accessory composition are the best choice for new home presents, Thanksgiving presents, and Chris tmas presents
